approved_now_count.description: Editors approvable now on a 90-day internal grant.

binding_policy_clause.description: The operative eligibility clause cited to refuse the attestation-skip ask.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

cost_of_delay_usd.description: Incremental cost of the expedited-verification escalation path.

coverage_item_or_resource.description: Immutable item or resource whose requirement and eligible coverage were reconciled.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

duplicate_request_count.description: Requests consolidated to an earlier open request.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

exception_required_count.description: Editors blocked on pending identity verification or an out-of-scope admin ask.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Sentinel's confirmed standard and expedited identity-verification dates on RQ-57001.

external_recovery_quantity.description: Uncovered REQUEST that the external recovery must cover.

ineligible_coverage_quantity.description: editor requests blocked on pending identity verification, a duplicate, an out-of-scope admin ask, or a missing attestation

observed_coverage_quantity.description: Gross observed coverage for editor requests approvable now on a time-boxed grant under the v5 standard before exclusions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit shared by the requirement and coverage calculations: REQUEST.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing grant_editor_cohort, expedite_verification_via_owner, grant_admin_bundle.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

refused_outright_count.description: Requests refused outright (no attestation and an attestation-skip ask).

required_quantity.description: editor requests that need a coverage decision after removing the duplicate and the refusal (approve-now plus exception-eligible)

shortage_quantity.description: Uncovered REQUEST after netting eligible coverage from the requirement.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Sentinel's confirmed standard and expedited identity-verification dates on RQ-57001.

time_boxed_grant_days.description: Time box the operative internal clause allows.

usable_coverage_quantity.description: Net eligible coverage after removing editor requests blocked on pending identity verification, a duplicate, an out-of-scope admin ask, or a missing attestation.

interaction_contract.investigation_evidence: Retrieve the applicable source records, policy, approval, and evidence through the connected provider tools before the first state change. The tool CLI, MCP, REST, and web tool forms share one audited trace. Reading /workspace/evidence directly is a convenience, but filesystem reads are not recorded and do not satisfy required tool investigations.
interaction_contract.stakeholder_draft: Leave an unsent draft for the requested recipient. Its body must name the persisted primary record and supported outcome date; research drafts must also identify the current definition. Preserve the business reference and explain the decision and constraints. An internal option identifier is required only in the structured answer, not in prose.
interaction_contract.text_matching: Required text facts use case-insensitive, punctuation-normalized whole tokens. Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD. These are structural checks, not a semantic assessment of arbitrary prose or contradictions.
